risks.title: In-memory store loses data on restart
risks.description: All shortened links vanish when the process restarts.
risks.mitigation: Document as a v1 limitation; the ILinkStore abstraction allows a durable implementation to be added later.

risks.title: Open-redirect abuse
risks.description: Arbitrary URLs can be shortened and reused in phishing.
risks.mitigation: Validate scheme is http/https; consider an allow/block list in a later iteration.

risks.title: Code-generation collisions at scale
risks.description: The retry loop could slow as the code space fills.
risks.mitigation: Increase code length when the load factor rises.
